text:
Cole Perfetti is having the breakout season Winnipeg has been waiting for since it took him 10th in 2020. He's playing 18:21 a night, up from 15:37, and he's on the ice for 91% of the Jets' power-play chances after 50% last year. The result: 14 points in 18 games (0.78 a game, against 0.47 last season), seven of them on the power play, and his own chances up to 1.60 expected goals per 60 from 1.08.

He's 24, and this isn't a hot-shooting mirage. His seven goals came on 8.8 expected (the quality of his chances), so he's slightly under, not over. His goals have been worth 1.46 wins by our numbers, 23rd in the league.

The caution is sample size: 18 games, and ice time settles faster than scoring. The last ten were quieter (six points, a minute less at even strength some nights). But a player who drives entries, shoots a lot and owns the top power play is a different player from the one who was fighting for a role. Our projection has him at about 27 goals.
